material.body: Evidence: a separate Chromium profile (--user-data-dir=/tmp/oscraft-peer-profile, debug port 9333) loaded the live Pages play.html. Clicking the join button via capture_browser_scenario connect mode left #status at room lobby / peers 0 (local) / joined and the lobby at lobby 1/10 after 10 s. The host page (gm shared Chrome) also reads peers 0. Related to peer-offer-not-retried-join-race. Next: capture console and network events from both pages to see whether the offer is sent.
material.resolution: Claim refuted on the live build; no code change.
material.subject: Join click in a second Chrome profile leaves peers at 0 (local)
